name: Claude Issue Triage
description: On every new issue, posts an @claude triage request that applies type/priority/component labels, hypothesizes the root cause, suggests a fix, and estimates effort. Requires CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN (for the Claude API) and TRIAGE_PAT (fine-grained PAT, Issues=R/W). See https://github.com/adamcongdon/.github for full setup.
